policy_note: Mirrors the English track's own existing policy: outputs/reports/ is gitignored with no exception (generated PDFs are reproducible from tracked code + data + the tracked BERT run evidence, so only this hash record is tracked, not the PDF bytes themselves). Confirmed with User (Yuji Sunagawa) 2026-08-05.
report_pdf_sha256_note: report.pdf's SHA-256 is NOT stable across re-renders of byte-identical report.md -- the Chrome-based renderer in tools/pdf_renderer is not byte-deterministic (observed 3 different report.pdf hashes across 3 renders of the same report.md while fixing the render_report_pdf_ja.py layout-overrides bug on 2026-08-05). report_md_sha256 is the stable, meaningful hash for 'did the content change'; re-record report_pdf_sha256 after every re-render rather than expecting it to match.

known_issue_resolved.description: A 2026-08-04 daily report narrative entry stated the report's BERT Accuracy as 0.737. Direct inspection of report.md, report generation source code, and an independent audit script confirmed the actually-generated value was always 0.797 (the correct 5-fold mean, matching a manual recomputation). The string '0.737' does not appear in report.md, report.pdf, or any report-generation source file; it appears only in the 2026-08-04 daily report's prose, which was a manual transcription error unrelated to any code path.
